_comment: Themes classify every skill for Ask-kb's router and generated catalogue. Profiles are optional install bundles for `bin/skills-sync select`; `core` is always installed. metadata.requires are installed automatically; metadata.lazy-requires are read from the library when needed.

themes.name: Coding
themes.summary: Software development, maintenance, and engineering workflows.

themes.name: Writing
themes.summary: Creating, editing, reviewing, and understanding prose and documents.

themes.name: Productivity
themes.summary: Planning, organizing, learning, and decision workflows.

themes.name: Misc
themes.summary: Specialized workflows that do not fit Coding, Writing, or Productivity.

profiles.name: core
profiles.summary: Default-loaded entry points: route, grill, and implement. Always installed.

profiles.name: coding
profiles.summary: The daily engineering flow: idea, spec, tickets, implement test-first, review, debug.

profiles.name: deep-review
profiles.summary: Heavier lenses for big or risky changes: major-change review, blast radius, design comparison.

profiles.name: typescript
profiles.summary: TypeScript/JavaScript rules and fallow static analysis (needs the fallow CLI).

profiles.name: agent-ops
profiles.summary: Long-running or unattended agent work: fan-out, decision trails, resuming, verification skills.

profiles.name: productivity
profiles.summary: Learning, questionnaires, clarifying confusion, and plain-prose editing passes.

profiles.name: writing
profiles.summary: KB's essay and reading workflows. Personal to KB's voice; adapt before relying on them.

profiles.name: business
profiles.summary: Test ideas and value propositions, audit consequential decisions, company blog posts.

profiles.name: maintainer
profiles.summary: Write and maintain skills in your own fork: authoring guide, tier moves, instruction updates.

profiles.name: design
profiles.summary: Deliberate visual design for UI work: aesthetic direction, typography, layout, interface copy.
